findings.text: follow-on: reference extraction is now gated on the facility's declared data_systems, so a facility declaring neither mdsplus nor tdi stops extracting MDSplus paths and TDI calls that the previous code extracted unconditionally. ITER declares only imas, so its MDSplus/TDI code references are no longer extracted; a metadata dict with no facility_id leaves handlers empty and extracts no references at all. Confirm the coverage change is intended or declare the missing systems for the affected facilities.

follow-on: _split_and_extract and _write_file_example dispatch on handler.linker identity (is link_chunks_to_data_nodes / is link_chunks_to_edas_signals) rather than an explicit kind carried by ReferenceHandler, so a future handler that shares a linker would be silently mis-routed; naming the kind on the NamedTuple would make the contract explicit.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit 9575c60b5..1c2862d93: 9575c60b5 adds REFERENCE_HANDLERS/reference_handlers_for_systems and routes pipeline and graph writes through them; 1dfbe3cee, 2a835906d and 1c2862d93 refresh the evidence fragment, the counts and the snapshot timestamp.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fragment now gives the per-type chunk count and resolution share (EDDB 13/15/0, UDDB 5/5/5, total 16 chunks / 20 mentions / 5 resolved = 25%) plus a config-routing table, a resolved-UDDB control, and a search_code check; the new tests pin each call form with two negative controls I reproduced.
item_verdicts.goal: §44 asks for an EDAS extractor beside ingestion/extractors/mdsplus.py and an ingest path that reuses it. The gained commits make the ingest path select its reference handlers from each facility's declared data_systems (imas_codex/ingestion/extractors/__init__.py:27-50, imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:95) and thread facilities' facility_id through EDAS linking (imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py:51-70), which satisfies the 'runs in the ingest path' clause, but selecting handlers by config also changes extraction for facilities beyond JT-60SA, which §44's text does not ask for.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records a 41-passed focused gate (1dfbe3cee, focused-config-gate.log), a 123-passed ingestion gate, a negative control removing eddbreadTime (4 failed, EXIT=1), and the backfill/search-check logs. The delivered after_suite (502a9622d, head-gate-current.log, 39 passed, EXIT=0) is the pre-gain baseline.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --name-only 502a9622d..1c2862d93 lists exactly the six paths the reviewed manifest and this node's goal declare: the evidence fragment, extractors/__init__.py, ingestion/graph.py, ingestion/pipeline.py, tests/graph/test_code_reference_links.py and tests/ingestion/test_edas_extractor.py.

justifications.durability: two new guards fire under mutation: removing the EDAS-config refusal in graph.py makes test_edas_backfill_requires_declared_data_system fail (EXIT=1), and making reference_handlers_for_systems ignore config fails all four routing cases; both mutations were restored with a clean diff.
justifications.evidence: the fragment now reports the per-type counts (EDDB 13 chunks/15 mentions/0 resolved, UDDB 5/5/5, total 16 chunks/20 mentions/5 resolved = 25%), a per-facility routing table matching the four configs, a resolved-UDDB control and a config-routing gate line; the counts reconcile with the run manifest's artifacts. I reproduced the 41-passed focused gate and 214 ingestion/discovery tests on the reviewed tree.
justifications.fit: ReferenceHandler is a NamedTuple in the extractors package beside the extractor functions, reference_handlers_for_systems is a module-level pure selector, and no symbol, filename, comment or commit subject carries a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ingestion/extractors/__init__.py:27-50 adds REFERENCE_HANDLERS and reference_handlers_for_systems and imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:95,301,705 select handlers from get_facility(facility).get('data_systems'), so the extractor runs in the ingest path as §44 requires; imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py:51-70 makes link_chunks_to_edas_signals take a keyword-only facility_id and refuse a facility without EDAS. The deliverable is met, but the config gating also changes extraction for facilities beyond JT-60SA.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the existing extractor functions and _generate_ref_id and GraphClient idioms, deduplicates the shared MDSplus/TDI handler through dict.fromkeys, and adds no parallel capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 502a9622d..1c2862d93 lists exactly the six declared paths; no out-of-scope file is touched.
